description.en: A large public university in Kraków. Foreign students pay tuition, and the amount is set separately for each programme; fees for programmes in English are published on the programme pages of the university.
description.ru: Крупный государственный университет в Кракове. Иностранные студенты платят за обучение, сумма определяется отдельно для каждой программы; цены программ на английском опубликованы на страницах программ университета.

requirements.entrance_exams: Online entrance exam in English, 100 multiple-choice questions in 180 minutes (reasoning and critical thinking in pre-medical sciences: biology, chemistry, mathematics/logic, ethics). Chemistry and either biology or physics must have been studied at secondary level.

notes_for_reviewer: Official uj.edu.pl pages read 2026-10-25. Medicine in English: EUR 16,000 per year for each of 6 years (EUR 96,000 in total), application fee PLN 100; round 1 of 2026 was 23.02-29.04.2026 (passed), no 2027 dates found, so deadlines are empty; the entrance exam, IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 87 and the chemistry plus biology-or-physics requirement are from the programme page. The page lists the level as 'undergraduate (long-cycle)': stored as master with 6 years. European Studies BA (3 years) and MA (2 years) at the Institute of European Studies: the page gives only totals for 2026/27 (EUR 13,200 = 6 instalments of 2,200; EUR 9,000 = 4 instalments of 2,250), the same for non-EU and EU students; stored as period 'total'. Other English programmes of the university (Erasmus Mundus, joint masters with partner universities, Business and Finance Management and others) are NOT collected: their fees and dates differ or are paid to partner universities. Application deadlines for the Institute programmes and the general English-taught master's schedule (first round 23.02-24.06, second round until 02.09; academic year not named on the page) were not stored. Founding year, rankings and dormitory are left empty.
